==Description==
'''v2.12.0''' is the one hundred and fifty-sixth update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 25th of September 2026.

This update encompassed one version, the main v2.12.0 update (released 25 September 2026).

==Changes & Bugfixes==
===Towers===
*[[Executioner]] reworked.
**Reworked Bounces thing
**Statistical changes:
***'''Base'''
****Placement cost increased from {{Money|750}} to {{Money|1,800}}.
****TBA
***'''Level 1'''
****Cost increased from {{Money|250}} to {{Money|450}}.
****TBA
***'''Level 2'''
****TBA
***'''Level 3'''
****TBA
***'''Level 4'''
****TBA
***'''Level 5'''
****TBA
*[[Executioner]] is obtainable through a gamepass for {{Robux|799}}.

===Miscellaneous===
*Fixed existing [[Hacker]] skins breaking their animations upon [[Revive|reviving]] in a match.
*Fixed [[Pulse Trooper]] not contributing DPS counter.
*Fixed [[Pulse Trooper]] lacking lead detection at Level 2.
